annotations.title: PayPal Fee Calculator and Invoice Gross-Up Estimator

description: Computes US PayPal Checkout (3.49% + $0.49), Card Fields (2.99% + $0.49), Pay Later, Micropayments, Invoicing Bank ACH (1% capped at $10), international +1.5% surcharges, reverse invoice gross-up, and Stripe comparison. Same math as https://modevc.com/tools/paypal-fee-calculator.

amount_usd.description: Transaction or desired net amount USD. Default 1000.

fx_spread_pct.description: Currency conversion spread percent when international is true. Default 0.

international.description: True for cross-border international buyer (+1.50%). Default false.

monthly_tx_count.description: Monthly transaction count for monthly/annual comparison vs Stripe. Default 50.
